Voter Count Decreases Significantly in Uttarakhand and Indore Rolls

Following a Special Summary Revision (SIR), the final electoral roll in Uttarakhand shows a reduction of 12.70 lakh voters compared to the January 2025 list, bringing the total to 71.58 lakh. This represents a 15.07% decrease. In Indore, 1.36 lakh voters were removed from the electoral roll after the SIR, with reports suggesting missing data from the Election Commission's IT branch. Across Uttarakhand, 8.26 lakh voters were marked as absent in the final list.
